data_note: Built from publisher RSS metadata (titles + teaser text). `coverage_window_hours` is the default (40h); several feeds use a longer `rollingHours` (see `scripts/build-digest.mjs`) so rows align with what is still on each publisher’s listing pages. Commercial Observer keeps its retail category + hub supplement; TRD adds a New York–filtered global retail tag feed. PincusCo uses the live site feed only (`/category/retail/feed/` is stale). **CRE Daily** retail briefs come from `credaily.com/sectors/retail/feed/`. **WSJ** is the Dow Jones real-estate feed with lifestyle and opinion dropped. **The New York Times** keeps real-estate and property stories only. **Traded** is commercial deal briefs from its news listing. Open each link for the full article (subscriptions may apply in the browser).

Italian Kitchen Manufacturer Officine Gullo to Open Store at 95 Madison Avenue: Hey now, hey now , these kitchens are what dreams are made of. Italy’s Officine Gullo , a manufacturer of luxury commercial and residential kitchens, has taken 3,200 square feet of ground-floor retail space at Sunlight Development ’s 95 Madison Avenue in Manhattan’s NoMad neighborhood, Commercial Observer has learned.

Snowflake Spa to Open New Location at 619 Ninth Avenue in Hell’s Kitchen: It’s giving self-care vibes. Snowflake Spa , a massage therapy and wellness provider, is getting ready to open another location in Manhattan’s Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood at 619 Ninth Avenue .

Nuveen Acquires $445M Retail Portfolio Across Three Western States: Nuveen Real Estate has acquired a 13-property retail portfolio in California, Colorado and Washington for $445.5 million in what is likely one of the largest grocery-anchored shopping center transactions in the Western U.S. in recent years.

AT&T Renews 7K-SF Lease at Rudin’s 3 Times Square: Home is where the heart is, and telecommunications giant AT&T is quite at home in the heart of Times Square . The wireless carrier has renewed and extended its lease at Rudin ’s 3 Times Square for another five years, Commercial Observer has learned.

The 10-year lease represents Officine Gullo’s new flagship space in New York City.…

items.headline: Snowflake Spa to Open New Location at 619 Ninth Avenue in Hell’s Kitchen
items.summary: It’s giving self-care vibes. Snowflake Spa , a massage therapy and wellness provider, is getting ready to open another location in Manhattan’s Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood at 619 Ninth Avenue . The tenant inked a 10-year, 2,200-square-foot lease for ground-floor and basement retail space at the mixed-use property, tenant broker Lee & Associates NYC announced Wednesday.…

items.headline: Nuveen Acquires $445M Retail Portfolio Across Three Western States
items.summary: Nuveen Real Estate has acquired a 13-property retail portfolio in California, Colorado and Washington for $445.5 million in what is likely one of the largest grocery-anchored shopping center transactions in the Western U.S. in recent years. The portfolio is 93.5 percent leased. It includes 1.89 million square feet of open-air retail space, with six properties in California, four in Colorado and three in Washington, according to an announcement Monday from JLL , which represented Nuveen in the acquisition.…

items.headline: Institutions Turn to JVs for Grocery-Anchored Retail
items.summary: Institutional investors are using joint ventures to gain exposure to retail, especially grocery-anchored centers, citing supply-and-demand fundamentals and long-term income growth. Investors want experienced operators with leasing, tenant-mix and local-market know-how, while operators get capital in return for acquisitions, development and redevelopment. JV equity is still hard to raise amid high rates, valuation uncertainty and buyer-seller gaps, so some investors are buying stakes in operating companies instead.…

items.headline: Grocery-Anchored Retail Premium Hinges on Store and Lease
items.summary: Grocery-anchored retail is among the most competitive investment niches, with 2025 transaction volume near $11B and cap rates averaging 6.7%, but the grocery label alone doesn’t justify a premium. Buyers should study store sales, the grocer’s competitive position and remodel plans, plus lease terms such as sales-based termination rights, co-tenancy clauses and replacement restrictions.…

items.headline: AT&T Renews 7K-SF Lease at Rudin’s 3 Times Square
items.summary: Home is where the heart is, and telecommunications giant AT&T is quite at home in the heart of Times Square . The wireless carrier has renewed and extended its lease at Rudin ’s 3 Times Square for another five years, Commercial Observer has learned. AT&T occupies 6,623 square feet of ground-floor and lower-level retail space at the 925,000-square-foot Midtown office tower . AT&T moved into the 30-story property, located on Seventh Avenue between West 42nd and West 43rd streets, in 2008.…

items.headline: Got Your Six Cannabis Dispensary Secures Manhattan Flagship
items.summary: A cannabis store is opening its Manhattan flagship location at the base of a luxury Tribeca condominium building. Got Your Six , a licensed dispensary based in New Jersey, has signed a 2,300-square-foot lease at 256 West Street , also known as 92 Laight Street . The corner retail lease between Laight and Vestry streets occupies part of the ground floor at Riverloft Condominiums , a 13-story luxury complex, and is near Hudson River Park . Crain’s New York first reported on the deal.…

items.headline: NBA Store Seeks New, Larger Location Up to 25K Square Feet
items.summary: Jump ball. The NBA Store, which is operated by Fanatics -owned sports apparel company Lids , is planning to relocate from its longtime retail location at 545 Fifth Avenue into a larger space, Commercial Observer can first report. The retailer of team jerseys, collectibles and other basketball-related merchandise is exploring seven potential locations around Midtown Manhattan to expand from its current 15,000 square feet of sellable retail space that it has leased since 2015 at the corner of 45th Street and Fifth…

items.headline: Carnegie Diner & Cafe Operator to Open New Restaurant at 7 Penn Plaza
items.summary: Carnegie Hospitality is opening its next Carnegie Diner & Cafe in Manhattan’s Penn District. The restaurateur signed on the dotted line last month to take over fast-casual chain Smashburger ’s lease at the Feil Organization ’s 7 Penn Plaza , Commercial Observer has learned. The tri-party deal included a 10-year lease extension for the 5,609-square-foot retail space at the corner of Seventh Avenue and West 31st Street.…

items.headline: Mexican Eatery Casa Carmen to Open Third Manhattan Location
items.summary: Mexican restaurant Casa Carmen is opening its third Manhattan location in Midtown East, Commercial Observer has learned. The restaurant concept started by chef Carmen “Titita” Ramírez Degollado signed a 15-year, 6,917-square-foot lease to serve up traditional Mexican cuisine at Sage ’s 437 Madison Avenue , according to tenant broker Retail by MONA as well as the landlord . Asking rent for the space was $200 per square foot, according to Retail by MONA.…

items.headline: PSP and Nuveen Launch $790M Grocery-Anchored Retail JV
items.summary: PSP Investments and Nuveen Real Estate launched a joint venture with an initial $790M to buy open-air shopping centers anchored by grocers, necessity retailers and essential services. The partners have closed about 3M SF across 19 properties in eight states, including two portfolios of six centers (801,000 SF) and 11 properties (1.9M SF). PSP says it is narrowing U.S. retail exposure to grocery-anchored centers that deliver inflation-linked income, a bet on daily-needs tenants and high-barrier metros.…

items.headline: Financial Tech Platform Intuit Takes 4K SF at the Orchard in LIC
items.summary: The Orchard , Queens’ tallest residential tower, has signed several new retail leases totaling 7,468 square feet, building owner and developer BLDG Management announced Thursday. In September, financial services platform Intuit , the company behind programs including TurboTax , QuickBooks , Credit Karma and Mailchimp , signed a 3,546-square-foot lease at the 70-story property at 42-06 Orchard Street in Queens’ Long Island City neighborhood.…

A regional bank’s senior loan and preferred equity from a national REIT financed the deal, and the center ranked as Texas’ third most-visited retail destination in 2025, per Placer.ai.…

items.headline: Retail Starts Hit a 10-Year Low as Pipeline Falls to 58.3M SF
items.summary: CoStar says 58.3M SF of retail was under construction in Q3, down from 60.6M SF in Q2 and 63.3M SF in Q1, roughly 4% under the 10-year average of 60.7M SF. New starts totaled about 7.7M SF, down from 10.7M SF in Q2 and the lowest quarterly figure since at least 2016, as elevated land, construction and borrowing costs strain feasibility. Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston and Austin hold nearly 27% of the national pipeline, and CoStar expects further shrinkage before any meaningful recovery.…

items.headline: Southern California Retail Vacancy Falls to 6.15% in Q3
items.summary: Retail tenants absorbed about 757,600 SF across Los Angeles and Orange counties and the Inland Empire in Q3 2026, while overall vacancy dropped 12 basis points to 6.15%. Orange County vacancy fell 25 basis points to a five-year low of 3.55% with rents up 3% to $2.65 per SF, while the Inland Empire led absorption at 527,000 SF. Los Angeles County lagged with 50,000 SF of absorption, down 77% from Q2, so the recovery is uneven even as community centers lead and construction stays limited.…

items.headline: Retail, Residential Landlord Hubb NYC Signs 12K-SF Deal at 1501 Broadway
items.summary: A residential and retail property owner has signed a deal to relocate its offices to the Paramount Building in Midtown. Hubb NYC signed an 11,578-square-foot lease on the fifth floor of Levin Management Corporation and Rosemark Management ’s 1501 Broadway in a move from Stawski Partners ’ 579 Fifth Avenue , according to CBRE .…

items.headline: Hudson Valley Boutique Shop Signs Lease in Manhattan’s Nolita
items.summary: A Beacon, N.Y., knickknack shop is making its New York City debut with a store in Manhattan’s Nolita neighborhood, Commercial Observer has learned. Solstad House General Store signed a five-year, 1,200-square-foot lease at Emmanuel Stark ’s 167 Mott Street , with an asking rent of $6,750 per month, according to broker Meridian Retail Leasing .…

items.headline: Finance Firm Webull Takes 42K SF at 140 Broadway
items.summary: Webull may wobble, but it won’t fall down. Online investment and brokerage platform Webull has taken 41,781 square feet at 140 Broadway in Manhattan’s Financial District, Commercial Observer has learned. The firm will occupy the entire 41st floor of the office property, as well as a portion of the building’s 40th floor. The asking rent was not disclosed. The length of the lease is for 10 years, according to tenant brokerage Colliers .…

items.headline: Law Firm Vedder Inks 49K SF Lease at 1221 Avenue of the Americas
items.summary: Vedder , an international business-focused law firm with over 400 lawyers and other employees around the world, is relocating its New York City office to Rockefeller Group ’s 1221 Avenue of the Americas , the property owner announced Monday. The law practice will relocate in 2027 from 1633 Broadway , about four blocks from its future home. The asking rent was not disclosed, and the length of the lease was described as a “long-term” deal.…

items.summary: Brooklyn Powerhouse Sports , a new fitness and athletic training facility, is opening its first location. The company will set up batting cages and a small office at the location.…

items.headline: Life Time Inks 20-Year Lease at Crescent Heights’ Miami Dev Site
items.summary: Health club chain Life Time is coming to Miami’s Edgewater neighborhood. The high-end gym operator, formerly known as Life Time Fitness, signed a 20-year lease at 3180 Biscayne Boulevard , a 2.6-acre, full-block development site owned by Crescent Heights , according to documents filed to Miami-Dade County. The gym will likely be part of a mixed-use development using the Live Local Act , a Florida law that grants developers faster approvals if at least 40 percent of units are priced as workforce housing.…
